name: QuietBox 2 vs DGX Spark
description: Justin Garrison's benchmark harness and results page comparing a Tenstorrent QuietBox 2 against one and two NVIDIA DGX Sparks on open-weight models: time to first token, decode speed per user, total throughput, wall power and running cost under coding-agent-shaped traffic, with quality scores from the Artificial Analysis index.
author: Justin Garrison
